SELECT * INTO D360.STG_EDS_AREA_DIM_20240426 FROM D360.STG_EDS_AREA_DIM; GO

SELECT * INTO EDS.AREA_DIM_20240501 FROM EDS.AREA_DIM; GO

SELECT TOP 5 SOLIDSET_SET_ID, SOLIDSET_SOL_ID, * FROM EDS.AREA_DIM

select * from om.om_task_run where (task_name like '%setid%' or  task_name like '%solidset%') and data_layer = 'EDS'

select * from om.om_task_run WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_AREA_DIM'

--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE
--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE
--TRUNCATE TABLE EDS.AREA_DIM

1.
DECLARE @DATEPROCESS DATE
SET @DATEPROCESS  = '2023-09-01'

SELECT  'DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE' TBLS ,COUNT(1) CNT FROM EDS.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE WHERE SUBSTRING(DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE.SET_ID, 1, 2) = 'AR' AND @DATEPROCESS BETWEEN SCD_Start_Date AND SCD_End_Date UNION ALL
SELECT  'DEP_SETIDTABLE' TBLS ,COUNT(1) CNT FROM EDS.DEP_SETIDTABLE WHERE SUBSTRING(DEP_SETIDTABLE.SET_ID, 1, 2) = 'AR' AND  @DATEPROCESS BETWEEN SCD_Start_Date AND SCD_End_Date UNION ALL
SELECT  'AREA_DIM' TBLS ,COUNT(1) CNT FROM EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE  @DATEPROCESS BETWEEN SCD_Start_Date AND SCD_End_Date 

2.
select * from om.om_task_run where task_name IN ('TSK_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE','TSK_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE')

UPDATE om.om_task_run SET PROCESS_DATE = '2023-08-31'  WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE'

select * from om.om_task_run where task_name IN ('TSK_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE','TSK_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE')

UPDATE om.om_task_run SET PROCESS_DATE = '2023-09-01'  WHERE TASK_NAME IN ('TSK_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE','TSK_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE')

UPDATE om.om_task_run SET PROCESS_DATE = '2023-08-31'  WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE'


2. Sample Data for Initial Load.

SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN2',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1089' will be updated on the next run (SOLIDSET TABLE)
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1172' will be updated on the next run (SET TABLE)
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1574' will be deleted from the source on the next run
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMME1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1123' will have no change in details, only filename date will be changed
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN99',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='9999' will be inserted as new record in the source on the next run(not yet inserted on the target table)


SELECT SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME, SETID_FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,* FROM
EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN2' AND SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1089'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME, SETID_FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,* FROM
EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1' AND SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1172'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME, SETID_FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,* FROM
EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMME1' AND SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1123'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME, SETID_FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,* FROM
EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1' AND SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1574'
UNION ALL
SELECT SOLIDSET_FILE_NAME, SETID_FILE_NAME,SCD_Start_Date,SCD_End_Date,SOLIDSET_LCHG_USER_ID,SETID_LCHG_USER_ID,* FROM
EDS.AREA_DIM WHERE SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN99' AND SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='9999'


3. Run scripts to fabricate updated, deleted , new record and update filename date

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] SET LCHG_USER_ID='UPDATE_TEST_123'
WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN2' AND SOL_ID='1089' AND H ='D';GO

UPDATE [D360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE] SET LCHG_USER_ID='UPDATE_TEST_123'
WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN1';GO

DELETE FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]
WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN1' AND SOL_ID='1574' AND H ='D';GO

UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20230901','20231215');GO
UPDATE [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE] SET FILE_NAME=REPLACE(FILE_NAME,'20230901','20231215');GO


INSERT INTO [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]
(H,SET_ID,SOL_ID,BANK_ID,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,DUMMY_FLD,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm)
SELECT 'D','ARMIN99' SET_ID, '9999' SOL_ID,BANK_ID,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,DEL_FLG,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,TS_CNT,DUMMY_FLD,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE]  
WHERE SOL_ID='1123' AND SET_ID='ARMME1';


SELECT FILE_NAME,SET_ID,SOL_ID,LCHG_USER_ID FROM
[d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN2' AND SOL_ID='1089'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SET_ID,'NA',LCHG_USER_ID FROM
[D360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SETIDTABLE] WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN1'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SET_ID,SOL_ID,LCHG_USER_ID FROM
[d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN1' AND SOL_ID='1574'
UNION ALL
SELECT FILE_NAME,SET_ID,SOL_ID,LCHG_USER_ID FROM
[d360].[STG_EDS_DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE] WHERE SET_ID='ARMIN99' AND SOL_ID='9999'



5. Sample Data for Initial Load.

SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN2',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1089'  (updated)
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1172'  (updated)
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1574'  (deleted )
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN99',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='9999'  (new)
SOLIDSET_SET_ID='ARMIN1',SOLIDSET_SOL_ID='1123'  (unchanged details with change infilename date only)
